summary: Production-hardening E2E verification for Anjali Herbal Life. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_production_hardening.py (11 tests) covers admin login rotation, OTP fail-safe & admin block, removed reset-data backdoor, ₹100 rules at approval vs activation (idempotent), 70% depth-based product commission (L1 20% / L2 12% on non-activation product), activation orders NOT paying purchase commission, withdrawal atomic aggregates + reject/mark_paid, and refund clawback (idempotent). All 11 pass (one transient ConnectTimeout on Withdrawal cleared on retry). Frontend smoke verified: /login (Login with OTP + Forgot password links present, no dev/test OTP text, no '4242', no 'Reset BETA Data'), /register loads, admin login at /admin-secure-login succeeds with new creds and admin dashboard renders (22 users, 15 GREEN, 7 RED). /admin/settings has no 'Withdrawal Minimum' field, no reset-data controls.

minor.issue: Pending list still accumulates TEST_* stale requests from prior runs; no bulk cleanup endpoint available by design.
ADMIN_PASSCODE has hardcoded 'admin123' fallback when env is empty. In production the env is set so this isn't triggered, but the default should be None to fail closed.

Brute-force lockout counter keyed only on lowercased email identifier; DID/mobile attempts count under a different bucket -> lockout can be bypassed by rotating identifier form. Carry-over from iteration_11.

action_items: Optional: harden ADMIN_PASSCODE default to None so a missing env var fails closed instead of accepting 'admin123'.
Optional: fix login brute-force key to always normalize to canonical user id after user lookup (still open from prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py:18 – `ADMIN_PASSCODE = os.environ.get('ADMIN_PASSCODE') or 'admin123'` — insecure fallback. Should raise or be None.

shop_routes.py `manual_payment_by_distributor` picks the latest unpaid order (line 599) — correct for tests but is order-agnostic; if a distributor has both an activation order AND a product order pending, the newest wins which may confuse operators.

admin_routes.py `review_withdrawal` uses `$inc` on `pending_balance`/`available_balance` without a guard that the request is still `pending` — approving an already-paid/rejected withdrawal twice would double-modify aggregates. Add a status-conditional filter to the update to make it truly idempotent.

One activation order per created distributor and 2 product orders (one refunded). Kept intact for follow-up inspection; delete via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} if cleanup desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 production-hardening tests pass. Non-blocking observations (admin passcode fallback, brute-force key normalization, withdrawal review idempotency) are documented above. If test data cleanup is desired, delete TEST_* users and products via admin DELETE endpoints (no bulk reset by design).
